# immich-mcp

MCP server for Immich photo library management. Semantic photo search, album management, facial recognition, OCR text-in-image search, upload/export. Requires Immich v2.4.0+.

> Full reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Key Tools
- **Photo search** — CLIP-based semantic search, text/EXIF metadata search
- **Album management** — create, list, add to, share albums
- **People / faces** — facial recognition, tag people, search by person
- **OCR search** — multilingual text-in-image search with bounding boxes (v2.3+)
- **Upload / import** — photo upload, library management
- **Export / backup** — export and backup photos
- **Storage info** — server storage health

## Ports
| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 10838 | Dashboard frontend (Vite) |
| 10839 | Backend (FastAPI + MCP HTTP) |

## Quick Start
```bash
uv sync && uv run immich-mcp
```

Set `IMMICH_URL` and `IMMICH_API_KEY` in `.env`.
